comment: The architecture defers protocol details and testing to IHE where a matching transaction exists. It does not explain how the architecture selects a specific IHE profile, version, option, national extension, or security environment.

public.text: The architecture defers protocol details and testing to IHE where a matching transaction exists. It does not explain how the architecture selects a specific IHE profile, version, option, national extension, or security environment.
public.suggestedRevision: Require a national profile-selection record specifying version, actors, options, content profile, transport, security, terminology bindings, national constraints, and applicable tests.
